groups.name: Assessments
groups.line: Start here. Each one tells you where your revenue engine stands and which skills to run next.

skills.name: GTM readiness scan
skills.line: A 24-question quick scan or a 120-question deep scan. Scores 8 domains from 0 to 5 and names your weakest ones.

skills.name: Bowtie benchmark
skills.line: Asks for your funnel metrics, benchmarks each one for your deal size, and writes a scorecard with the biggest leaks.
skills.credit: Benchmarks recreated from Winning by Design

skills.name: CRM scorecard
skills.line: Turns a raw CRM export from any CRM into bowtie conversion rates, benchmarked, with the top two leaks named.
skills.credit: Built on Winning by Design's bowtie

skills.name: SPICED call scorecard
skills.line: Scores call transcripts on the five SPICED dimensions with word-for-word evidence, and writes the follow-up questions.
skills.credit: SPICED is a Winning by Design framework

skills.name: GTM diagnostic
skills.line: Measures the full revenue engine, names the main cause, and produces a 30-60-90 day plan.
skills.credit: Built on Winning by Design's frameworks

groups.name: Product-market fit
groups.line: Prove who to sell to and why they buy.

skills.name: Customer dossier
skills.line: One timeline per account from CRM, calls, billing, usage and support, with the source on every field.
skills.credit: Concept from Jordan Crawford's The Dossier

skills.name: Win-loss rewind
skills.line: Works back from won, lost and churned customers to the situations that predict a buyer, checked on a 20% holdout.
skills.credit: Method by Jordan Crawford, Blueprint GTM

skills.name: ICP agent
skills.line: Defines your ideal customer profile as red, yellow and green, with a weighted scoring model.
skills.credit: Red, yellow, green from Mark Roberge's Science of Scaling

skills.name: ICP objection mapping
skills.line: Role-plays your most skeptical buyer before a campaign, so the copy answers the objections first.

skills.name: Conversational intelligence
skills.line: Pulls handoff notes, competitor mentions, expansion signals and loss reasons out of call transcripts.

skills.name: Blueprint swarm
skills.line: Reads hundreds of calls in parallel and checks its own output for made-up claims.
skills.credit: Based on Jordan Crawford's open-source Blueprint Swarm

groups.name: GTM fit
groups.line: Build a sales motion that repeats and pays for itself.

skills.name: Meeting prep
skills.line: A research brief for any sales meeting, with SPICED questions written for that contact and company.
skills.credit: Uses Winning by Design's SPICED and Science of Scaling's six questions

skills.name: Battlecard builder
skills.line: A competitor battlecard in 30 minutes that reps can use in the middle of a call.
skills.credit: Three-card framework from Science of Scaling

skills.name: PQS and PVP messaging
skills.line: Turns one signal or data point about a prospect into a cold email that mirrors their situation or hands them an insight.
skills.credit: PQS and PVP by Jordan Crawford, voice rules by Josh Braun

skills.name: Research playbook
skills.line: A 10-minute method to find one real signal per prospect for a cold email.

skills.name: QA checklist
skills.line: The standard a cold email has to pass before it ships, with a score.

skills.name: Follow-up sequences
skills.line: A multi-touch sequence where each email brings a new reason to reply.

skills.name: TAM data cost estimate
skills.line: Prices a market map before you build it: one-off data cost, monthly cost and subscriptions, each as a range.

skills.name: CRM enrichment cost estimate
skills.line: Estimates the yearly Clay credits and actions to enrich the records already in your CRM.
skills.credit: Model follows Clay's public scoping template

skills.name: Free-first domain resolver
skills.line: Turns company names into verified domains, free sources first, and refuses to guess when it cannot confirm.
skills.credit: Idea by Jordan Crawford, Blueprint GTM

skills.name: Claygent prompt generator
skills.line: Writes Clay research prompts in the order that keeps the cost per row low.

skills.name: Claygent builder
skills.line: Builds a Clay research agent, tests it, and improves it until the output is good enough to trust.

skills.name: GTM AI brief
skills.line: Turns a task you keep doing by hand into a written brief an AI can run, tested before it ships.

skills.name: Playbook generator
skills.line: One company domain in, a full outbound playbook out: pain segments, data sources and messages.
skills.credit: Method by Jordan Crawford, Blueprint GTM

groups.name: Growth and moat
groups.line: Scale the motion, measure it, and defend it.

skills.name: Outcome seller scoring
skills.line: Scores recorded calls per rep on SPICED, then simulates what closing the coaching gap is worth in revenue.
skills.credit: Built on Winning by Design's SPICED and Outcome Seller webinar

skills.name: Compound growth check
skills.line: Takes six or more quarters of revenue and tells you whether growth is compounding or decaying.
skills.credit: Growth states from Winning by Design

skills.name: AI use case gate
skills.line: A go or no-go check for an AI idea before anyone builds it.

skills.name: Epistemic context grounding
skills.line: Makes the AI check what is actually known before it designs a solution.
skills.credit: By Jacob Dietle, MIT licence

skills.name: Context gap analysis
skills.line: Lists what the AI needs to know, checks what exists, and finds the simplest way forward.
skills.credit: By Jacob Dietle, MIT licence

groups.name: Clay prompts
groups.line: Small research and scoring prompts for Clay columns and Claygent. One job each.

skills.name: Prompt engineering rules
skills.line: Five rules for enrichment prompts that stay cheap and reliable at volume.
skills.credit: Rules taught by Eric Nowoslawski, Growth Engine X

skills.name: Metaprompter
skills.line: Asks the AI what context, examples and edge cases a prompt is missing, then rewrites it.
skills.credit: Technique taught by Eric Nowoslawski, Growth Engine X

skills.name: B2B or B2C
skills.line: Classifies a company as B2B, B2C or both, and suggests the tone to match.

skills.name: SaaS identification
skills.line: Decides whether a company is SaaS, and what that means for the message.

skills.name: Company mission
skills.line: Pulls a one-sentence mission from a company's LinkedIn or About page.

skills.name: Company goals
skills.line: Reads a company's open jobs and infers what it is trying to do this year.

skills.name: Ideal customer profiles
skills.line: Finds the buyers, users and industries a company serves, from its public content.

skills.name: Pricing strategy
skills.line: Pulls a company's pricing model, tiers and sales motion from its pricing page.

skills.name: Recent news
skills.line: Finds a company's most relevant recent news and turns it into outreach angles.

skills.name: Glassdoor rating
skills.line: Finds and reads a company's Glassdoor rating, and says when it is safe to mention.

skills.name: Data point research
skills.line: Designs fit signals that data providers do not sell, with a prompt to detect each one.
skills.credit: "Build data you can't buy" by Petra Hajal

skills.name: PLG company detection
skills.line: Detects whether a company is product-led: freemium, free trial, hybrid or sales-led.
skills.credit: Approach by Petra Hajal

skills.name: Multi-product detection
skills.line: Detects whether a company sells one product, several, or a suite.
skills.credit: Approach by Petra Hajal

skills.name: Product complexity detection
skills.line: Rates how complex a company's product is, from docs, reviews, jobs and pricing.
skills.credit: Approach by Petra Hajal

skills.name: Pain-qualified segment
skills.line: Defines a segment by two to five signals that show active pain, not only company size.
skills.credit: Concept by Jordan Crawford, Blueprint GTM

skills.name: List is the message
skills.line: Builds a list around one detectable tension, so the message follows from why each lead is on it.
skills.credit: Idea by Jordan Crawford, Blueprint GTM

skills.name: Customer evidence first
skills.line: Builds positioning from the real reasons won customers bought, not from features.
skills.credit: Idea by Jordan Crawford, Blueprint GTM

skills.name: Permissionless value proposition
skills.line: Writes outreach that gives a useful insight from public data before it asks for anything.
skills.credit: Concept by Jordan Crawford, Blueprint GTM

skills.name: Lead scoring
skills.line: Designs a lead score from fit, intent and custom signals, with point tables and action tiers.

skills.name: Dynamic ICP scoring
skills.line: Builds a weighted ICP score from enriched data that returns JSON with hot, warm and nurture tiers.
skills.credit: Approach by Patrick Spychalski, The Kiln

skills.name: Clean job titles
skills.line: Turns long LinkedIn job titles into clean titles with seniority and function.

skills.name: Role focus
skills.line: Describes what a job title usually cares about: metrics, pains and authority.

skills.name: LinkedIn posts summary
skills.line: Sums up a prospect's recent LinkedIn posts into themes and hooks you can use.

skills.name: Email subject line
skills.line: Writes three personal subject lines under eight words from prospect research.

skills.name: Email opening line
skills.line: Writes a personal first line that continues from the subject line.

skills.name: Playbook pitch generation
skills.line: Generates a pitch per account: angle, hook, proof point, objection and next step.
skills.credit: Approach by Patrick Spychalski, The Kiln

others.name: GTM workspace skills
others.line: One git-backed workspace for your company facts, ICPs and personas, plus saved workflows that run locally or on Vercel.

others.name: Call and pipeline audits
others.line: One sales call transcript or CRM export in, one audit out, with a quote behind every finding. Covers MEDDICC, BANT, SPICED-style discovery, deal risk and pipeline stage checks.

others.name: Cold outbound
others.line: Eric Nowoslawski's team on domain setup, list building, deliverability and cold email copy.

others.name: Clay agent plugins
others.line: Clay's own skills for tables, workflows, audiences and searches, plus skills from Clay's community.

others.name: Clay tables from code
others.line: Rex: design a Clay table as a file, import it, and check what it will cost before it runs. Unofficial, not made by Clay.

others.name: GTM engineering skills
others.line: Prospecting, enrichment, scoring and plays that run against a data warehouse.

others.name: Revenue orchestration
others.line: Skills for building and running go-to-market workflows in Cargo.

others.name: Context OS quickstart
others.line: A starter for a knowledge system your AI builds on over time. Two of his skills ship in our repo, with credit.

others.name: Open Source GTM directory
others.line: A community list of public repos for GTM teams: products, agent skills, libraries, templates and learning material.
